meta.note: Detail dressing for San Francisco (same frame as sf_layout.json). rail: surface tracks from OSM (the F-line streetcar on Market St and the Embarcadero, Muni Metro on the Embarcadero / King St / 3rd and 4th Streets, Caltrain's depot throat) as raw polylines; elevated = on a bridge. streetcar: ONE clean ordered polyline per line, clipped to the play box: 'F Market & Wharves' (from the box's south-west edge up Market St to the Ferry Building, then the Embarcadero and Jefferson / Beach St to Fisherman's Wharf; the inbound track of the OSM route relation) and 'Embarcadero - King St' (Muni Metro N/T surface track from the Ferry portal south along the Embarcadero and King St to 4th & King). cableCar: one clean ordered polyline per line (outbound route relation), stops in line order and the turntables at the line's ends. ferries: real routes out of the Ferry Building, Pier 41 and Pier 33 running out past the bounds (first point at the dock, clipped at 1500 u). piers: the deck polygons of sf_layout parks with surface 'pier'. seawall: the bulkhead line behind the piers (the land edge with the pier fingers removed), polylines. bayBridge, alcatraz, goldenGateBridge, sutroTower, containerShip: the far set pieces at their true positions (outside the box).

bayBridge.note: West span of the San Francisco - Oakland Bay Bridge (1936): two suspension bridges end to end sharing the centre anchorage W4, grey-silver steel, double deck. points = deck centreline (mean of the OSM carriageways) from the approach viaduct on Rincon Hill past the San Francisco anchorage out to Yerba Buena Island (the tunnel portal is just past the last point). Towers and anchorages are placed by the bridge's published span lengths (354 / 704 / 354 m each side of W4) measured back along the centreline from the island shore; tower heights above water.

containerShip.note: Anchorage 9, the big-ship anchorage south of the Bay Bridge off the eastern waterfront: open bay water outside the box to the south-east

alcatraz.note: true position north of the box; rot = rotation.y of the island's long axis (local +X)

goldenGateBridge.note: true position, far west-north-west; x / z = mid-span, rot = rotation.y with the deck along local +X (south tower to north tower); bearing / distance from the origin

sutroTower.note: Sutro Tower, the red-and-white three-legged TV mast on the hill between Twin Peaks and Mount Sutro; top 552 m above sea level
